coordinate_system: Y-up, character forward is +Z, character right is +X

character.proportions: neutral adult-proportioned anatomical reference; do not infer exact body measurements from poster
character.mesh: single watertight skinned character mesh where practical

materials.muscle_highlights: red translucent overlay, separate mesh/material layer

rig.deform_quality: clean joint deformation at shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees

exercise.name: Push-Up
exercise.equipment: floor mat or stable non-slip floor
exercise.setup: Hands on floor slightly wider than shoulder width; body in a straight plank line; feet supported on floor.

keyframes.label: start_high_plank
keyframes.pose: elbows extended but not forcefully locked; shoulders over or slightly ahead of wrists; head aligned with spine; pelvis neutral; legs straight.

keyframes.label: lowering
keyframes.pose: bend elbows under control; lower chest and hips together; maintain a stable trunk; elbows angled naturally rather than flared straight sideways.

keyframes.label: bottom_controlled
keyframes.pose: reach a comfortable depth while keeping trunk aligned; do not force the shoulder range.

keyframes.label: press_up
keyframes.pose: press the floor away; extend elbows smoothly; keep hips from sagging or rising ahead of the chest.

keyframes.label: return_start
keyframes.pose: return to stable high plank; brief pause.

form_checks: head, torso, pelvis and legs remain aligned
left and right sides move symmetrically
use a comfortable range of motion
exercise.safety_note: Use a stable, non-slip surface. Stop if movement causes pain; use an easier incline variation if a floor push-up is not controlled.
